Zoho Co-Founder Advocates R&D Decentralization for Job Creation

Zoho Co-Founder Sridhar Vembu has stated that India needs to decentralize its research and development (R&D) efforts to create jobs outside of major metropolitan areas. He also expressed a lack of concern regarding predictions of AI-induced doom, advocating for India to adopt an independent approach to artificial intelligence development and invest in foundational R&D.
